summary: Broker Network V2 module fully tested: backend (BN1-BN5) via pytest 15/15, frontend (BN6-BN8) via Playwright. CRITICAL PII-leak check on /api/v2/public/req/<token> PASSED — response contains only whitelisted Requirement fields (RequirementCode, Category, SubCategory, TransactionType, Location1/2, BHK, BudgetMin/Max, CarpetAreaMin/Max, FurnishingPreference, Purpose, Timeline, ReadyToMove, Amenities) plus BrokerName; no LeadID/ClientName/PrimaryMobile/Phone/Email leaked. NetworkSubmission property lands in /api/v2/inventory with correct attribution and auto-adds a '[Network]' prefixed shortlist row against REQ-0001. Revoke → REVOKED, negative-expiry → EXPIRED. Mongo persistence verified via supervisorctl restart realty. All frontend pages (/broker-network, /share/req/<token>, /client-workspace share modal) work with WhatsApp deep-link generation.

minor.issue: expiresInDays=0 silently coerces to 30 via `Number(x) || 30` (falsy). Not a blocker (UI defaults to 30) but a caller passing 0 would be surprised. Consider `Number.isFinite(x) ? x : 30`.

critical_code_review_comments: server.js is ~2630 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; consider splitting v2 route groups into their own routers.
brokerNetworkV2Service._anonymize is correctly whitelist-based (safe). Good pattern.
expiresInDays=0 falsy fallback edge case (see minor issue).

submitResponse writes db twice indirectly (mutates in place, then this.repo.write). Fine but repo.read() is called once and mutated — ok because repo.write(db) is called at end. No race issue in single-process node but note for concurrency.

Public POST /response has no rate-limit / no anti-spam captcha; production risk since URL is WhatsApp-shareable and anyone with token can submit unlimited properties. Consider ResponseCount cap or per-token throttle.
test_credentials: DEMO_MODE auto-auth as USR-0001; public endpoints need no auth.
seed_data_creation: Test brokers/shares/inventory rows prefixed TEST_ created during run (broker deleted at end of BN1; other TEST_ brokers + a NetworkSubmission property + shortlist row remain — safe to leave for main agent inspection).
context_for_next_testing_agent: REQ-0001/LEAD-0001 exists and is used for network-share tests. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_broker_network_v2.py is idempotent (uses timestamp-based unique phones). Frontend was tested at 1440x900. All BN1-BN8 flows verified end-to-end incl. PII leak guard.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing user-reported bug. Only observed edge case: `expiresInDays: 0` falls back to 30 due to JS truthiness. Trivial fix if desired.
